breakdown.description: `IBRION = -1` together with `NSW = 0` turns the run into a static calculation even though the workflow requires a structural relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses IBRION = 2 and NSW = 99, which enables a proper structural relaxation (conjugate gradient algorithm with up to 99 ionic steps). This matches the ground truth and fixes the original error where IBRION = -1 and NSW = 0 would have resulted in a static calculation instead of a relaxation.
